limitations: Authored fictional cases are not an independent blind test or a public benchmark.
Model is a provider alias; temperature 0 is not a guarantee of deterministic hosted responses.
End-to-end latency here is text input to structured candidate, excluding microphone, ASR, sign generation and rendering.
Local ambiguity fast paths count as zero provider calls/tokens and are reported separately.
One observation per case/arm; wall-clock timing is affected by network, concurrent load and provider prompt caching.
Case-level bootstrap is conditional on this authored dataset; related domain/template families are not independent random user samples.
Internal taskSuccess means structured reference/draft-presence/update-target/date correctness, not action/material correctness, natural-language reply quality or sign-language comprehension.
